content:
Best practice is to just unsubscribe from Gmail's "All Mail" pseudo folder. It's not relevant to a standards-based email agent like Thunderbird, and it just tends to confuse the user, as you discovered.

To Unsubscribe, right-click on the Gmail account name in the Folders List and choose "Subscribe" from the pop-up context menu. This will show all the available IMAP folders. Remove the check mark beside "All Mail" and the folder will no longer be visible in Thunderbird.
